**The build passes now.** You were right, one warning hid a real crash.

Two files still read the old option names:
1. `src/core/options.js` wanted `retries`. The new name is `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when a flag was unset. Unset now means off.

The 8 remaining warnings are printed text inside `build.js`. Nothing real behind them.
